verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents docs-usage analytics: a Developer Metrics API to "see how people use your docs" and an "API & Docs Metrics Charts" page. Readers can also share feedback through Suggest in GitHub. But the evidence never names page-view counts, search-term reports, or an in-product feedback dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit page-view metrics, search-term analytics, a reader feedback rating/report view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I see page views, search terms, and reader feedback so I know which docs work and which fail

citations.quote: See how people use your docs and how developers use your API
They can use Suggest in GitHub to flag typos or share user feedback.
